test_title: PYST 35: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

#: OSR:: JNM:%
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Option 1) # = ROU, % = GKQ**

**For # (ROU) to OSR**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f2bbb23229bfafaafac75cbde4c3aa5c1ee31394771d365a99d6a794cb0584f.png] 

 

**For JNM to % (GKQ)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5e25bc7c0d14b3bc4c39e7786ff8fd322f913662fd17818d7b7073b43eaa29a.png] 

 

Since the pattern for ROU to OSR (-3, +4, -3) is not the same as the pattern for JNM to GKQ (-3, -3, +4), Option 1 is incorrect.

**Option 2) # = UQU, % = GOZ**

**For # (UQU) to OSR**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94e125d44d668ec260a0bb0c86f3598ec66c5961449f04d5012edb986ed8f733.png] 

 

**For JNM to % (GOZ)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/000beebeda4d4adb89c0ed729e07294132f92432022984a96f250ebb2e7896c8.png] 

 

Since the pattern for UQU to OSR (-6, +2, -3) is not the same as the pattern for JNM to GOZ (-3, +1, +13), Option 2 is incorrect.

**Option 3) # = IUU, % = GBQ**

**For # (IUU) to OSR**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/746b9d80b0fe8b34efe451c7459e0d6fbf3dee2e85a9be490bc11657c3262cc1.png] 

 

**For JNM to % (GBQ)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54fb1084f65096b7f03ad5a6cdd1ecf73b2c2be531e0ed159391459ee83b2265.png] 

Since the pattern for IUU to OSR (+6, -2, -3) is not the same as the pattern for JNM to GBQ (-3, -12, +4), Option 3 is incorrect.

**Option 4) # = RVU, % = GKJ**

**For # (RVU) to OSR**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03a39d03717ff6cc370af2c6fec94c63e0dab6f7214fabf334d38630e9b09b7f.png] 

 

**For JNM to % (GKJ)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0ea53f073c4c8fd7f2b2c4bc2ad170a1632f72294aaab00d0078602d443404a.png] 

 

Option 4 is correct.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
